Gerunds after prepositions · 专项练习(第3轮): A verb after a preposition takes the gerund: at/in/on/of/for/about + V-ing.本课为专项练习练习,核心:Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。
be good at + V-ing|be interested in + V-ing|instead of + V-ing|look forward to + V-ing (to is a preposition)|before/after + V-ing as object
She is good at drawing pictures.
She is good at to draw pictures.|She is good at draw pictures.|She is good at draws pictures.|She is good at drawing pictures.
column4: Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:She is good at drawing pictures.
